enchantments.name: Returning Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, star silver, magnetic stone
enchantments.text:
Immediately after you make a thrown attack with the weapon, it returns to your hand if you have a free hand. If you do not, it lands in your space.
The weapon cannot return while inside an area that blocks teleportation or extradimensional movement.

enchantments.name: Unbreaking Temper
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, mountain jade, black gold
enchantments.text:
The weapon has Resistance to all damage dealt to objects and Advantage on saving throws against effects that would break, corrode, suppress, or permanently deform it.
If the weapon would be destroyed while it has at least 1 Hit Point, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point. Once this protection functions, it cannot function again until the weapon is repaired during a Long Rest or downtime.

enchantments.name: Meridian-Conducting Channels
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit jade, conductive metals, beast sinew
enchantments.text:
You can use the weapon as a focus for Sphere actions and item activations that require a held focus.
Whenever you deal damage with a Sphere action while holding the weapon, you can change one damage type dealt by that action to a damage type produced by another enchantment on the weapon.
This does not change the Sphere action’s other tags or prerequisites.

enchantments.name: Flame-Vein Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Sun copper, phoenix ash, fire beast cores
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d4 fire damage.
You can ignite or extinguish the weapon’s flame as a Bonus Action. While extinguished, this additional damage does not apply.

enchantments.name: Frost-Meridian Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Cold iron, frost jade, glacial crystal
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with the weapon, it takes an additional 1d4 cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
Speed reductions from this enchantment stack to a maximum reduction of 15 feet.

enchantments.name: Thunder-Conducting Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Storm iron, thunderwood, lightning beast cores
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d4 lightning damage.
If the target is wearing metal armor or is made primarily of metal, the additional damage becomes 1d6.

enchantments.name: Gale-Edge Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Wind jade, cloud steel, spirit bamboo
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a Large or smaller creature with the weapon, you can move it 5 feet horizontally to an unoccupied space.
The target can make a Strength saving throw against your item save DC to negate this movement. After a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this enchantment until the start of your next turn.

enchantments.name: Mountain-Weight Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mountain jade, heavy iron, Xuanhuang-infused material
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d4 force damage.
If the target is Large or larger, an unattended object, or a structure, the additional damage becomes 1d8.

enchantments.name: River-Flow Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: River jade, water silver, spirit reed
enchantments.text: After each time you hit a creature with the weapon, you can move up to 5 feet without provoking an Opportunity Attack from that creature.

enchantments.name: Venom-Bloom Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Poison beast fangs, toxic jade, alchemical alloys
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with the weapon, it takes an additional 1d4 poison damage.
A creature immune to the Poisoned condition takes no additional damage from this enchantment unless the finished weapon explicitly overcomes that immunity.

enchantments.name: Cloud-Riding Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Cloud steel, wind jade, crane feather
enchantments.text:
While wielding the weapon, your Speed increases by 5 feet.
When you take the Dash action, you can move across liquids and vertical surfaces during that movement. If you end the movement without a supporting surface, you fall.

enchantments.name: Pursuing-Star Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Star silver, sun gold, comet stone
enchantments.text:
Attacking at long range with the weapon does not impose Disadvantage.
The weapon’s ranged attacks ignore Half Cover.
If the weapon normally lacks a ranged attack, this enchantment has no effect unless combined with Returning Inscription, Flying Sword Command, or another property that gives it one.

enchantments.name: Ghost-Slaying Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Peach wood, spirit iron, prayer jade
enchantments.text:
The weapon can damage creatures on the Ethereal Plane as though they were on your plane, provided they are within the weapon’s normal reach or range.
Whenever you hit an Undead or an incorporeal creature, it takes an additional 1d6 radiant damage.

enchantments.name: Soul-Guarding Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Soul jade, bodhi wood, guardian metal
enchantments.text:
While wielding the weapon, you have Advantage on saving throws against possession and effects that would directly control your actions.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail such a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new result.

enchantments.name: Balanced-Grip Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit iron, cloudwood, beast sinew
enchantments.text:
While you are conscious and wielding the weapon, it cannot be disarmed from you unless you choose to release it.
Drawing or stowing the weapon does not consume your free object interaction.

enchantments.name: Hidden-Sheath Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Voidglass, moon silver, spatial jade
enchantments.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can transform the weapon into a Tiny ornamental object chosen when the enchantment is created, such as a ring, hairpin, bracelet, belt clasp, or jade token. The transformed weapon weighs 1 ounce and cannot be used to make attacks.
As a Bonus Action, you can return it to its weapon form in your hand. If you have no free hand, it appears in your space.
A creature physically inspecting the ornament can identify it as transformed equipment with a successful Intelligence (Arcana) check against your item save DC.

enchantments.name: Long-Reach Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit bamboo, voidglass alloy, star silver
enchantments.text:
If the weapon is a melee weapon, its Reach increases by 5 feet during your turn.
This does not increase the weapon’s Reach for Opportunity Attacks unless another property explicitly says otherwise.
If the weapon already has Reach, this increase stacks with that property.

enchantments.name: Stonebreaker Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Black iron, mountain jade, heaven-splitting stone
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a Construct, an unattended object, or a structure, it deals an additional 1d6 force damage.
The weapon’s attacks against those targets ignore Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

enchantments.name: Beast-Hunter Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit-beast bone, dragonfang ivory, beast sinew
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a Beast or Monstrosity, it deals an additional 1d4 damage of the weapon’s normal damage type.
You have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track a creature damaged by the weapon within the previous 24 hours.

enchantments.name: Blood-Scent Tracking Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Blood jade, beast fang, crimson steel
enchantments.text:
When the weapon deals damage to a creature that has blood, you can mark that creature until you mark a different creature or complete a Long Rest.
While the marked creature is within 1 mile and on the same plane, you know its direction but not its exact distance. The mark ends if the creature regains all its Hit Points.
A creature can identify and remove the mark during a Short Rest with a successful Wisdom (Medicine) check against your item save DC.

enchantments.name: Soundless Edge Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Hush jade, shadow iron, black bamboo
enchantments.text:
The weapon produces no sound when drawn, moved, or used to make an attack.
An attack made with the weapon does not reveal your location solely through sound. Other evidence, including sight, impact, displaced objects, blood, or visible effects, can still reveal you normally.

enchantments.name: Talisman Channel Groove
enchantments.preferred_materials: White jade, spirit iron, talisman wood
enchantments.text:
During a Short or Long Rest, you can attach one consumable talisman to the weapon. The talisman remains attached until removed, activated, or destroyed.
While the talisman is attached, you can activate it without holding it in a free hand. Its normal action type, range, targets, save DC, and other rules remain unchanged.
The weapon can hold only one talisman at a time.

enchantments.name: Formation-Sundering Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Source stone, star iron, formation jade
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a magical barrier, formation anchor, summoned object, or object created by a supernatural effect, it deals an additional 1d6 force damage.
The weapon’s attacks against those targets count as magical and ignore Resistance to the weapon’s bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

enchantments.name: Water-Cutting Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: River jade, deepsea cold iron, water silver
enchantments.text:
Attacks made with the weapon do not suffer Disadvantage or reduced range from being made underwater.
Whenever the weapon hits a creature that is swimming or fully submerged, it deals an additional 1d4 cold damage.

enchantments.name: Wood-Severing Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Refined steel, sun copper, dragonfang ivory
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a Plant creature or a wooden object or structure, it deals an additional 1d6 slashing damage.
The weapon’s attacks against those targets ignore Resistance to slashing damage.
If the weapon normally deals bludgeoning or piercing damage, the additional damage remains slashing damage.

enchantments.name: Corrosion-Vein Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Toxic jade, acid beast gland, alchemical alloy
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits, the target takes an additional 1d4 acid damage.
The weapon and its sheath are immune to nonmagical corrosion caused by acid, saltwater, rust, or similar environmental exposure.

enchantments.name: Resonant-Sound Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Thunderwood, bronze, resonant crystal
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits, the target takes an additional 1d4 thunder damage.
The impact is audible out to 100 feet unless another property suppresses the sound.

enchantments.name: Dream-Piercing Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Dream jade, moon silver, bodhi wood
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a creature that is Charmed, Frightened, Unconscious, or affected by a Dreams Sphere effect, it takes an additional 1d6 psychic damage.
The additional damage is applied before the target makes any saving throw caused by taking damage.

enchantments.name: Phasing Edge Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Ghost iron, voidglass alloy, spatial jade
enchantments.text:
Attacks made with the weapon ignore Half Cover provided by nonmagical objects and creatures.
The weapon can strike an incorporeal creature normally and can be drawn or moved through nonmagical restraints, scabbards, or containers no more than 1 inch thick.
This property does not allow attacks through Total Cover.

enchantments.name: Harvesting Edge Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit-beast bone, surgical steel, harvesting jade
enchantments.text:
You have Advantage on Intelligence (Nature), Wisdom (Medicine), and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to harvest useful materials from a creature using the weapon as a tool.
The time required for such harvesting is halved.
This property does not create additional material or increase a Harvest Lot’s grade.

enchantments.name: Qi-Sensing Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Source jade, soul jade, spirit iron
enchantments.text:
As an Action, awaken the inscription until the end of your next turn.
During that time, you perceive the location of active magical effects, qi inscriptions, attuned treasures, and creatures currently spending or maintaining CP or another Path resource within 30 feet. Total Cover blocks this sense.
Once used, this property cannot be used again until you complete a Short or Long Rest.

enchantments.name: Light-Bearing Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Sun crystal, moon silver, white jade
enchantments.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can cause the weapon to shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet, or extinguish that light.
Invisible writing, talisman ink, and formation marks within the Bright Light become visible if they are not behind Total Cover. This property reveals their location and shape but does not explain their function.

enchantments.name: Poison-Shedding Temper
enchantments.preferred_materials: Purified silver, medicine jade, serpent pearl
enchantments.text:
While wielding the weapon, you have Advantage on saving throws against the Poisoned condition.
As an Action, you can touch the weapon to one nonmagical food or drink container holding no more than 1 gallon. You learn whether its contents are poisoned, though not the poison’s identity.

enchantments.name: Gravity-Hook Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Magnetic iron, mountain jade, chain steel
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a Large or smaller creature, you can pull it 5 feet directly toward you.
The target can make a Strength saving throw against your item save DC to negate this movement. After a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this enchantment until the start of your next turn.

enchantments.name: Armor-Piercing Dao Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Star iron, black gold, dragon fang
enchantments.text:
Attacks made with the weapon ignore Resistance to its bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.
Whenever you hit a target that has none of those Resistances, the attack deals an additional 1d6 force damage.
This enchantment does not ignore Immunity.

enchantments.name: Radiant-Sun Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Sun gold, phoenix-blood metal, solar crystal
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d6 radiant damage.
If the target is Undead, a Fiend, or currently within magical darkness, the additional damage becomes 2d6.

enchantments.name: Moonless-Yin Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Moon silver, yin jade, grave iron
enchantments.text: Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d6 cold damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

enchantments.name: Solar-Yang Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Sun copper, phoenix-blood metal, golden jade
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d6 fire damage.
Until the start of your next turn, you have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened and against effects that would reduce your Speed.

enchantments.name: Five-Phase Cycling Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Five-phase alloy, balanced jade, five aligned beast cores
enchantments.text:
When you finish a Long Rest, choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 1d8 damage of the chosen type.
As an Action, you can spend 1 CP to change the selected damage type. The new type remains until changed again or until you finish a Long Rest.

enchantments.name: Chain-Binding Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Chain steel, dragon sinew, binding jade
enchantments.text:
When you hit a Large or smaller creature with the weapon, you can spend 1 CP to force it to make a Strength saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failure, its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

enchantments.name: Meridian-Sealing Point
enchantments.preferred_materials: Needle steel, white jade, spirit bone
enchantments.text:
When you hit a creature with the weapon, you can spend 1 CP to force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failure, it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn and cannot spend CP, Stamina, Resonance, or another Path resource during that time.
On a success, it cannot take Reactions until the end of the current turn.

enchantments.name: Silent-Heaven Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Hush jade, void glass, black bamboo
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with the weapon, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failure, it cannot speak or use effects requiring speech until the start of your next turn.
After a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this enchantment until the start of your next turn.

enchantments.name: Void-Nail Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Void crystal, star iron, spatial jade
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with the weapon, it cannot teleport or travel between planes until the start of your next turn.
If the target was already prevented from teleporting when the attack hit, it instead takes an additional 1d8 force damage.

enchantments.name: Soul-Locking Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Soul jade, ghost iron, spirit beast cores
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with the weapon, it takes an additional 1d8 psychic damage.
If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points before the start of your next turn, its soul cannot be moved, consumed, transformed, or trapped by another effect until the end of your next turn.
This does not prevent normal death, stabilization, or revival.

enchantments.name: Guardian-Reversal Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mirror steel, guardian jade, turtle shell
enchantments.text:
When a creature you can see hits you with an attack while you are wielding the weapon, you can use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to reduce the damage by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this reduces the damage to 0, you can move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

enchantments.name: Mirror-Polished Countermark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mirror steel, moon silver, polished jade
enchantments.text:
When a creature you can see misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to make one weapon attack against it.
You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you complete a Long Rest.

enchantments.name: Shadow-Passing Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Shadow iron, void glass, night jade
enchantments.text: When you hit a creature with the weapon, you can spend 1 CP to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of that creature.

enchantments.name: Spirit-Striking Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Heartwood, soul jade, ghost iron
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the attack deals an additional 1d8 psychic damage.
If the target is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead, the additional damage becomes 2d8.

enchantments.name: Weapon-Spirit Seed
enchantments.preferred_materials: Spirit-bearing materials, ancient weapon fragments, beast cores
enchantments.text:
The weapon develops a dormant spirit seed.
Choose one Instinct when the enchantment is created:
- **Guard.** Once per Long Rest, when you are hit by an attack, the weapon imposes a -1d6 penalty on the attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.
- **Pursue.** Once per Long Rest, when you miss with a weapon attack, the weapon rerolls the attack and must use the new result.
- **Warn.** You cannot be surprised while the weapon is on your person and not dormant.
- **Suppress.** Once per Long Rest, when you fail a saving throw against being Charmed, Frightened, or possessed, you reroll it and must use the new result.
The weapon spirit does not speak, take turns, or activate other properties unless later awakened.

enchantments.name: Ancestral Recognition Seal
enchantments.preferred_materials: Blood jade, ancestral metal, lineage relic fragments
enchantments.text:
When the enchantment is created, define one lineage, sect, oath, or named inheritance.
A qualifying bearer can attune to the weapon in 10 minutes rather than during a Short Rest.
A nonqualifying creature can wield the weapon as a nonmagical weapon but cannot use its enchantments, attack bonus, or damage bonus.
The seal’s qualification must be objective and written into the finished item. It cannot depend on an undefined judgment of worthiness.

enchantments.name: Tribulation-Tempered Growth
enchantments.preferred_materials: Tribulation-tempered metal, calamity crystal

enchantments.name: Blood-Drinking Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Blood steel, demon beast fang, crimson jade
enchantments.text:
Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points with the weapon, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier.
The weapon cannot gain this benefit from Constructs, creatures summoned by you, or creatures with a CR lower than one-quarter your Cultivation Level, rounded down.

enchantments.name: Life-Burning Overload
enchantments.preferred_materials: Blood jade, phoenix ash, cursed metal
enchantments.text:
When you hit with the weapon, you can expend one Hit Die and roll it.
The target takes additional fire or necrotic damage, chosen when the enchantment is created, equal to twice the number rolled.
You also take damage equal to the number rolled. This damage cannot be reduced or prevented.

enchantments.name: Flying Sword Command
enchantments.preferred_materials: Star silver, cloud-void crystal, spirit iron
enchantments.text:
As a Bonus Action while the weapon is in your hand, you can release it to hover in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. It remains hovering until you recall it as a Bonus Action, become Incapacitated, end your Attunement, or it moves more than 60 feet from you.
While the weapon hovers within 60 feet, you are considered to be wielding it, and one of your hands remains occupied for rules purposes. Whenever you make an attack with the weapon, the attack can originate from the weapon’s space. Before or after each such attack, move the weapon up to 30 feet through unoccupied spaces.
The weapon cannot pass through Total Cover and falls in its space if this enchantment ends.

enchantments.name: Sword-Light Missile Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Star silver, sun crystal, spirit jade
enchantments.text:
The weapon has 3 Sword-Light charges and regains 1d3 expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Sword-Light Missile.** As an Action, expend 1 charge and make a ranged item attack against one creature or object within 120 feet. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 force damage.
The missile travels in a straight line from the weapon and cannot pass through Total Cover.

enchantments.name: Blazing Detonation Seal
enchantments.preferred_materials: Sun copper, fire beast core, talisman steel
enchantments.text:
The weapon has 3 Detonation charges and regains 1d3 expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
When the weapon hits a creature, you can expend 1 charge to release a 10-foot-radius burst centered on that creature. Each other creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, a creature takes 3d6 fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
The creature hit by the weapon is not affected by the burst.

enchantments.name: Phasing Strike Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Ghost iron, origin-void copper, voidglass alloy
enchantments.text:
Attacks made with the weapon ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
An attack can pass through up to 5 feet of nonmagical solid matter if you can perceive the target through another sense or through an opening. The attack cannot pass through lead, a magical barrier, or Total Cover provided by more than 5 feet of matter.
The weapon does not create an opening in the matter it passes through.

enchantments.name: Qi-Disrupting Dao Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: White jade, ghost iron, meridian needle steel
enchantments.text:
When the weapon hits a creature, you can spend 1 CP to force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, the creature cannot take Reactions, and the save DCs of its Sphere actions, treasure effects, and other cultivation abilities are reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, it cannot take Reactions until the end of the current turn.

enchantments.name: Vitality-Returning Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Blood jade, phoenix-ash steel, medicine jade
enchantments.text:
Whenever you score a Critical Hit with the weapon or reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points with it, you regain Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You gain no healing from a Construct, a creature summoned by you, or a creature with a Challenge Rating lower than one-quarter your Cultivation Level, rounded down.

enchantments.name: Thousand-Needle Division
enchantments.preferred_materials: Needle steel, star silver, spirit bamboo
enchantments.text:
The weapon has 3 Division charges and regains 1d3 expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Thousand-Needle Division.** As an Action, expend 1 charge and choose a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet up to your Proficiency Bonus. Make one ranged item attack against each target.
On a hit, a target takes 2d8 piercing damage. A creature can be targeted only once by each activation.

enchantments.name: Formation-Anchor Breaker
enchantments.preferred_materials: Source stone, heaven-splitting stone, star iron
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a Construct, magical barrier, formation anchor, summoned object, or object created by a supernatural effect, it deals an additional 2d6 force damage.
The weapon’s attacks against those targets ignore Resistance to all damage dealt by the weapon, but not Immunity.
If the target is sustaining a visible area or barrier and is destroyed by the attack, that area or barrier ends immediately unless its rules state that it persists without the target.

enchantments.name: Talisman-Launching Groove
enchantments.preferred_materials: White jade, talisman wood, spirit iron
enchantments.text:
During a Short or Long Rest, attach one consumable talisman to the weapon. The weapon can hold only one talisman at a time.
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with activating the attached talisman, provided the talisman normally requires an Action or Bonus Action. The talisman uses its normal range, targets, save DC, and other rules, and is consumed normally.
If the talisman creates an effect originating from its user, it originates from you rather than from the weapon.

enchantments.name: Predator's Pursuit Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Demon-beast fang, blood jade, shadow iron
enchantments.text:
Whenever the weapon hits a creature, that creature cannot benefit from being Invisible against attacks made with this weapon until the start of your next turn.
You also know the direction and exact distance to any creature damaged by the weapon within the previous hour while it remains within 1 mile and on the same plane.
A creature that has no blood or spiritual essence, such as most unattended Constructs, cannot be tracked by this property.

enchantments.name: Sovereign Suppression Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mountain-root jade, heavy divine metal, sovereign beast core
enchantments.text:
**Suppressing Strike.** Whenever you hit a Huge or smaller creature, it must make a Strength saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failure, its Speed is reduced by 20 feet and it has Disadvantage on the next Strength or Dexterity saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. Further hits while this effect lasts do not require another saving throw.
On a success, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and it is immune to further saving throws from this enchantment until then.

enchantments.name: Devouring Furnace Mark
enchantments.preferred_materials: Devouring beast core, black furnace iron, abyssal jade
enchantments.text:
When the weapon reduces a hostile creature of CR 1 or higher to 0 Hit Points, it gains 1 Devouring charge, to a maximum of 3.
Whenever you hit with the weapon, you can expend 1 Devouring charge to deal an additional 2d8 necrotic damage and regain Hit Points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
All unused Devouring charges disappear when you complete a Long Rest.
The weapon gains no charge from Constructs, creatures summoned by you, or creatures created solely to be sacrificed.

enchantments.name: Calamity-Hungry Edge
enchantments.preferred_materials: Tribulation remnants, calamity crystal, divine metal
enchantments.text:
When you succeed on a saving throw against a damaging effect, the weapon stores 1 Calamity charge, to a maximum of 3.
Whenever you hit with the weapon, you can expend 1 Calamity charge to deal an additional 2d8 damage of a type dealt by the triggering effect that created the charge.
All unused Calamity charges disappear when you complete a Long Rest.

enchantments.name: Gravitational Prison Seal
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mountain-root jade, magnetic iron, heavy divine metal
enchantments.text:
When the weapon hits a Huge or smaller creature, you can spend 2 CP to force it to make a Strength saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, the creature is Restrained until the end of your next turn.
On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn, and it is immune to Gravitational Prison Seal until the start of your next turn.
A creature that is already Restrained by this enchantment is not required to make another saving throw when hit.

enchantments.name: Mirror-Heaven Reversal
enchantments.preferred_materials: Mirror-sea silver, moon silver, stillwater jade
enchantments.text:
When an attack made by a creature you can see damages you, you can use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to reduce the damage by `4d8 + your Proficiency Bonus`.
If this reduces the triggering damage to 0, make one ranged item attack against the attacking creature, provided it is within 120 feet and not behind Total Cover.
On a hit, the creature takes 4d8 force damage. This reflected attack is a separate attack and does not apply the weapon’s other on-hit enchantments.

enchantments.name: Thousand-Li Pursuit Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Star silver, blood jade, cloud-void crystal
enchantments.text:
This enchantment can be applied only to a ranged weapon, a weapon with the Thrown property, or a weapon bearing Flying Sword Command.
Attacks made with the weapon do not have Disadvantage at long range and ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
When the weapon damages a creature, you can mark it until you mark another creature or complete a Long Rest. While the marked creature is within 10 miles and on the same plane, you know its direction and exact distance.
The marked creature gains no benefit from being Invisible against attacks made with this weapon.
A creature can remove the mark during a Long Rest with a successful Wisdom (Medicine) or Intelligence (Arcana) check against your item save DC.

enchantments.name: Heaven-Splitting Edge
enchantments.preferred_materials: Divine metal, void crystal, tribulation-tempered steel
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit a creature or object with the weapon, it takes an additional 3d8 force damage.
If the target is an unattended object or structure, the additional damage is maximized.
The attack ignores Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and force damage, but not Immunity.

enchantments.name: Heaven-Calamity Inscription
enchantments.preferred_materials: Tribulation-tempered metal, thunder crystal, calamity beast core
enchantments.text:
Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes an additional 2d8 lightning damage.
**Calamity Descent.** Once per Long Rest, when you hit a creature, you can call down a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of tribulation lightning centered on it. Each other creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, a creature takes 8d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and suffers no other effect.
The original target automatically fails this saving throw but does not take the enchantment’s normal 2d8 additional lightning damage a second time.

enchantments.name: Space-Cutting Step
enchantments.preferred_materials: Void crystal, spatial jade, divine metal
enchantments.text:
Whenever you make an attack as part of the Attack action while wielding the weapon, you can teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see immediately before or after that attack.
This teleportation cannot pass through an effect that blocks teleportation.

enchantments.name: Awakened Weapon Spirit
enchantments.preferred_materials: A weapon already bearing Weapon-Spirit Seed
enchantments.text:
The weapon’s spirit awakens and can communicate telepathically with its attuned bearer while on the same plane.
Choose two Instincts from Weapon-Spirit Seed. Each selected Instinct can function once per Long Rest.
**Independent Guard.** When you are Incapacitated but not dead, the weapon can use one of its unused defensive Instincts without requiring your action.
The weapon remains an item and does not take independent turns.

enchantments.name: Dao-Vessel Foundation
enchantments.preferred_materials: A unique principal material compatible with the bearer’s intended Dao

enchantments.name: Ten-Thousand Sword Domain
enchantments.preferred_materials: Heaven-mark violet gold, star silver, formation jade
enchantments.text:
The weapon has 5 Domain charges and regains `1d4 + 1` expended charges when you complete a Long Rest.
**Open the Sword Domain.** As an Action, expend 3 charges to create a 20-foot-radius domain centered on you for up to 1 minute. You must maintain Concentration as though concentrating on a spell.
When a hostile creature enters the domain for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC. On a failed save, it takes 4d8 slashing damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
While the domain lasts, when you make an attack with this weapon, you can treat the attack as originating from any unoccupied point inside the domain that you can see. Determine range and cover from that point. The weapon remains in your possession.

enchantments.name: Law-Denying Edge
enchantments.preferred_materials: Origin-void copper, heaven-mark violet gold, sealing jade
enchantments.text:
When the weapon hits a creature, you can spend 3 CP and choose one ongoing effect on that creature that:
- has a duration longer than Instantaneous;
- originates from a spell, Sphere action, treasure, formation, or other supernatural ability;
- is perceptible to you or identified by a feature you possess.
The creature makes a Charisma saving throw against your item save DC.
On a failed save, the chosen effect is suppressed until the end of your next turn. While suppressed, it provides no benefit, imposes no condition, and cannot be activated or extended, but its duration continues to elapse.
On a successful save, the effect is not suppressed, and that creature is immune to Law-Denying Edge until the start of your next turn.
This enchantment cannot suppress Attunement, a creature’s Path or Foundation, an item’s existence, an instantaneous effect, or an Immortal Artifact property unless that property explicitly permits suppression.

enchantments.name: Heaven-Earth Severing Wave
enchantments.preferred_materials: Heaven-splitting stone, divine metal, cloud-void crystal
enchantments.text:
The weapon has 3 Severing charges and regains 1 expended charge when you complete a Long Rest.
**Sever Heaven and Earth.** As an Action, expend 1 charge to release a cutting wave in a line 120 feet long and 10 feet wide.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw against your item save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d8 force damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
Unattended objects and structures in the line take the maximum possible damage. A magical barrier or formation segment reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is destroyed immediately.

materials.name: Refined Hundred-Fold Steel
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Reliable Edge.** When you roll a 1 on one of the weapon’s normal damage dice, you can reroll that die and must use the new result.
This property applies only to the weapon’s base damage dice, not additional damage from enchantments or other features.

materials.name: Black Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Heavy Construction.** The weapon weighs twice as much as normal.
When the weapon deals damage to an unattended object or structure, add one additional weapon damage die.
A creature with a Strength score below 13 has Disadvantage on attack rolls made with the weapon unless the weapon has the Light property.

materials.name: Spirit-Beast Bone
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Living Grain.** The weapon counts as silvered against creatures whose resistance or immunity is bypassed by silvered weapons.
It also weighs half as much as an equivalent metal weapon.

materials.name: Cloudwood
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Flexible Balance.** If the weapon has the Two-Handed or Versatile property, drawing or stowing it does not require your free object interaction.
If it is a ranged weapon, its normal range increases by 10 feet.

materials.name: White Jade Composite
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Stable Inscription Surface.** The first time during a crafting project that an ability check made to inscribe or repair this weapon fails, the crafter can reroll the check and must use the new result.
This property has no effect after the weapon is completed unless it is later repaired or reforged.

materials.name: Spirit Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Qi Conduction.** While wielding the weapon, you can use it as a focus for Sphere actions and treasure activations that require a held focus.
The weapon counts as magical even before it receives an enchantment.

materials.name: Storm Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Residual Charge.** Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes 1 additional lightning damage.
If the target is wearing metal armor or is made primarily of metal, it takes 2 additional lightning damage instead.

materials.name: Moon Silver
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Pale Reflection.** The weapon sheds Dim Light in a 5-foot radius while drawn unless you suppress or restore the light as a Bonus Action.
Attacks made with the weapon ignore Disadvantage caused solely by dim light or nonmagical darkness.

materials.name: Sun Copper
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Solar Heat.** Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes 1 additional fire damage.
Against an Undead creature, the additional damage becomes radiant damage.

materials.name: River Jade
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Flowing Balance.** After you make an attack with the weapon, you can move 5 feet during the same turn without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of that attack.
You can use this movement only once during each of your turns.

materials.name: Thunderwood
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Resonant Strike.** Whenever the weapon scores a Critical Hit, the target takes additional thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The sound is audible out to 100 feet.

materials.name: Frost Jade
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Cold Edge.** Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target takes 1 additional cold damage.
The weapon cannot be damaged by ordinary fire or environmental heat.

materials.name: Spirit Bamboo
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Hollow Qi Channel.** The weapon weighs half as much as normal.
If the weapon has the Reach property, its Reach increases by 5 feet during your turn only.

materials.name: Mountain-Root Jade
materials.opposed_text: Air and teleportation effects unless stabilized
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Rooted Impact.** Whenever you hit a Large or smaller creature with the weapon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your item save DC or be moved 5 feet directly downward if airborne, or 5 feet horizontally away from you if grounded.
A creature that succeeds is immune to this material property until the start of your next turn.

materials.name: Star Silver
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Celestial Trajectory.** Ranged attacks made with the weapon ignore Half Cover.
If the weapon has the Thrown property, its normal and long ranges are doubled.

materials.name: Dragonfang Ivory
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Predatory Penetration.** Attacks made with the weapon ignore Resistance to piercing damage.
If the weapon does not deal piercing damage, it instead deals 1 additional force damage whenever it hits.

materials.name: Ghost Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Ethereal Edge.** The weapon can affect creatures on the Ethereal Plane as though they were on your plane, provided they are within the weapon’s normal reach or range.
Whenever you hit an incorporeal creature or an Undead creature, it takes 1 additional psychic damage.

materials.name: Phoenix-Ash Steel
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Rekindled Edge.** The weapon has Resistance to all damage dealt to objects.
If the weapon is broken but not disintegrated, placing it in a mundane or magical fire for 8 hours repairs it to full Hit Points.

materials.name: Voidglass Alloy
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Folded Reach.** The weapon’s melee reach increases by 5 feet for Opportunity Attacks.
If it is a ranged weapon, its normal range increases by 30 feet instead.

materials.name: Blood Jade
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Blood Recognition.** When you attune to the weapon, it records your blood signature.
A creature other than you has Disadvantage on attack rolls made with the weapon until it completes its own Attunement to it.

materials.name: Deepsea Cold Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Abyssal Cold.** Whenever you hit with the weapon, the target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn, to a maximum reduction of 15 feet from this material.
A creature immune to cold damage is immune to this Speed reduction.

materials.name: Tribulation Steel
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Calamity Memory.** When you succeed on a saving throw against lightning or thunder damage while wielding the weapon, it becomes charged until the end of your next turn.
While charged, each hit with the weapon deals 1 additional lightning or thunder damage, chosen when the charge is gained.

materials.name: Five-Phase Alloy
materials.preferred_enchantments: Five-Phase Cycling and any elemental enchantment
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Balanced Conduction.** When the weapon is completed, choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.
The weapon’s base bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage can be changed to the selected type whenever you make an attack with it.
You can change the selected type during a Long Rest using Smith’s Tools and one Spirit Shard.

materials.name: Soul Jade
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Soul Resonance.** Whenever you hit a creature with Intelligence 4 or higher, the weapon deals 1 additional psychic damage.
The weapon has Advantage on saving throws against possession or hostile item-spirit control.

materials.name: Heaven-Splitting Stone
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Structural Ruin.** Weapon attacks against unattended objects and structures deal double damage.
Against a creature wearing Heavy Armor or possessing Natural Armor of 18 or higher, the weapon deals 2 additional force damage whenever it hits.

materials.name: Cloud-Void Crystal
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Spatial Lightness.** The weapon weighs nothing while carried by its attuned bearer.
Drawing or stowing it requires no action, and it cannot be disarmed from the bearer unless the bearer is Incapacitated.

materials.name: Demon-Heart Iron
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Hungry Metal.** Whenever the weapon deals necrotic damage, add your Proficiency Bonus to one necrotic damage roll from that hit.
If the weapon deals no necrotic damage, this property provides no benefit.

materials.name: Mirror-Sea Silver
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Still Reflection.** While wielding the weapon, you have Advantage on saving throws against illusions.
When you succeed on such a saving throw, you immediately identify the source of the illusion if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover.

materials.name: Phoenix-Blood Scarlet Gold
materials.opposed_text: Deep Yin unless stabilized by an Imperial material
materials.preferred_enchantments: Fire, Radiant, Yang, Growth, Weapon Spirit
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Phoenix Authority.** Whenever the weapon hits, it deals 2 additional fire damage.
The first time each Long Rest that the weapon would be destroyed, it instead becomes dormant and drops to 1 Hit Point. It regains full Hit Points and ceases to be dormant after remaining in a magical fire for 1 hour.

materials.name: Heaven-Mark Violet Gold
materials.preferred_enchantments: Dao-Vessel Foundation, Weapon-Spirit, any coherent Sphere alignment
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Natural Dao Surface.** The weapon’s enchantment capacity increases by +1 Equivalent Bonus.
This increase cannot raise an Immortal Artifact beyond a bespoke limit established by its own entry.

materials.name: Calamity-Tempered Imperial Gold
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Tribulation Guard.** While wielding the weapon, you have Resistance to lightning damage.
If you already have Resistance to lightning damage, you instead reduce lightning damage you take by your Proficiency Bonus after applying Resistance.

materials.name: Immortal-Tear Verdant Gold
materials.opposed_text: Devouring effects unless stabilized by an Imperial material
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Sanctuary Edge.** While wielding the weapon, allied creatures within 5 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
The weapon also deals 2 additional radiant damage whenever it hits an Aberration, Fiend, or Undead.

materials.name: Dragon-Patterned Abyssal Gold
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Dragon Pressure.** Whenever the weapon hits a Huge or smaller creature, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your item save DC or be pushed 5 feet directly away from you.
After a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this material property until the start of your next turn.

materials.name: Feathered Celestial Green Gold
materials.opposed_text: Weight unless stabilized by an Imperial material
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Celestial Passage.** Attacks made with the weapon ignore Three-Quarters Cover.
If the weapon has the Thrown property or is used through a flying-weapon enchantment, its normal and long ranges are tripled.

materials.name: Primordial Mother-Weight Essence
materials.opposed_text: Air and Space unless reconciled by an Immortal formula
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — One Strand Weighs a Mountain.** Weapon attacks deal 4 additional force damage.
Whenever the weapon hits a Gargantuan or smaller creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your item save DC or be knocked Prone.
After a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this material property until the start of your next turn.
A creature with Strength below 20 cannot wield the weapon unless attuned to it.

materials.name: Origin-Void Copper
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Autonomous Counteraction.** While the weapon is on your person, you have Advantage on saving throws against possession, forced teleportation, and effects that would directly control your actions.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail one of those saving throws, the weapon allows you to reroll it and use either result.

materials.name: Enlightenment Tree Heartwood
materials.opposed_text: Devouring and corruption effects unless reconciled by an Immortal formula
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Dao-Clarity Grain.** While wielding the weapon, you have Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom ability checks made to understand inscriptions, formations, cultivation methods, Dao marks, or supernatural materials.
Once per Long Rest, after you fail such a check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 15.

materials.name: World-Heart Crystal
materials.opposed_text: Destructive Devouring effects unless explicitly integrated
materials.preferred_enchantments: Pocket Domain, Formation, Dao Vessel, Growth
materials.property_text:
**Material Property — Seeded Domain.** The weapon can serve as the anchor for a demiplane, formation domain, or growth-vessel property.
By itself, this material grants no portable interior space. The exact domain must be defined by a separate Immortal Artifact property with complete mechanics.
The weapon has Immunity to force damage dealt to objects and cannot be teleported against its bearer’s will.
